lines.en: We continue to focus on the television.
lines.zh: 我们继续盯着电视。

lines.en: It seems as if one of the girls has finished eating before the rest of them.
lines.zh: 看起来其中一个女孩比其他人都先吃完了。
或者……等等，实际上，也许她并没有？

lines.en: She stands up and grabs her plate, announcing to the others that she’s tired and is going to head to bed.
lines.zh: 她站起身拿起盘子，跟大家说她累了，要去睡了。

lines.en: A small girl with pink hair, almost the same color as Noriko's, chases after her, clearly upset with the decision.
lines.zh: 一个粉色头发的小个子女孩——发色几乎和 Noriko 一样——追在她后面，显然对这个决定很不高兴。

lines.en: But the one who stood up closes the door in her face, placing her plate of unidentifiable gray food (?) on the floor beside her mattress.
lines.zh: 但那个站起来的女孩当着她的面关上了门，把那盘无法辨认的灰色食物（？）放在床垫旁边的地板上。

lines.en: : What’s that thing in the corner of the room?
lines.zh: : 房间角落里那个东西是什么？

lines.en: : What thing? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么东西？你在说什么？

lines.en: : That big-ass metal tube thing. Do you not see it?
lines.zh: : 那个巨大的金属管子。你没看见吗？

lines.en: : Ooooh, that. Uhh...a water heater, maybe?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，那个啊。呃……也许是热水器？

lines.en: : It’s hard to tell since it’s cut off by the wall.
lines.zh: : 很难说，因为它被墙挡住了。

lines.en: : So...when does the stuff start happening?
lines.zh: : 那么……事情什么时候开始发生？

lines.en: A hand finds its way into my lap and I already have a good idea of where this is going.
lines.zh: 一只手摸进了我的大腿之间，我已经很清楚这是要往哪儿发展了。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Noriko. At this rate, your kotatsu is going to be destroyed.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Noriko。照这个速度，你的被炉要被毁了。

lines.en: : Huh...that’s so weird. This is actually a little different than I remember.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好奇怪。这跟我记得的不太一样。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s been a while since I’ve seen it, though, so I could be misremembering.
lines.zh: : 我是说……不过我已经有一阵子没看了，所以也可能是我记错了。

lines.en: : Actually, is this even the same thing I’ve watched before?
lines.zh: : 其实，这跟我以前看的那个是同一部吗？

lines.en: : The set looks the same and the girls look the same but I could have sworn that last time, they had like...actual food instead of that gray stuff.
lines.zh: : 布景一样，女孩也一样，但我发誓上次她们吃的像是……真正的食物，而不是那种灰色的东西。

lines.en: : But I guess it could just be the coloring of the TV that's making it look that way?
lines.zh: : 不过我想也许只是电视的色调让它看起来那样？
: 你觉得呢，Kirin？
: 我觉得这电影烂透了。

lines.en: : We’ve got Netflix. Why don’t we just watch something on that instead of this weird, arthouse crap?
lines.zh: : 我们有 Netflix。干嘛不随便在上面找点看，非要看这种奇怪的艺术垃圾？

lines.en: Kirin’s hand trails up my thigh to the zipper of my jeans, very slowly pulling it down so it doesn’t make any noise.
lines.zh: Kirin 的手顺着我的大腿摸到我牛仔裤的拉链，非常缓慢地把它拉开，好不发出一点声音。

lines.en: The way that she’s able to hold a conversation while doing this is actually quite impressive.
lines.zh: 她居然能一边做这种事一边维持对话，说实话相当令人佩服。

lines.en: Extremely bold and I guess slightly surprising, but definitely impressive.
lines.zh: 大胆至极，而且我觉得有点令人意外，但绝对令人佩服。

lines.en: : Hmm...yeah, I guess if nobody else is enjoying it, we can do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，既然没人喜欢看，那我们换一个吧。

lines.en: : That’s so weird, though. It’s usually a lot more intense than this.
lines.zh: : 好奇怪啊。平时它可比这个刺激多了。

lines.en: : Like, this one time, I watched one of the girls straight up hang herself and the others didn’t find out for like, three or four days.
lines.zh: : 比如有一次，我看着其中一个女孩直接上吊自杀了，其他人过了差不多三四天才发现。

lines.en: : Maybe this is just the prequel or something?
lines.zh: : 也许这只是前传什么的？

lines.en: : Sensei, is there anything you want to watch?
lines.zh: : 老师，你有什么想看的吗？

lines.en: : Ooh! I’m interested in hearing your tastes, too.
lines.zh: : 哦哦！我也很想听听你的口味。

lines.en: : I don’t think we’ve talked much about movies yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们还没怎么聊过电影。
: 呃……喂？老师？

lines.en: : Oh, uhh, sorry. I’m fine with anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃，抱歉。我什么都行。
: 嗯……你还好吗？

lines.en: : If you’re a little under the weather, maybe Noriko could run and grab you a bottle of water or something?
lines.zh: : 如果你有点不舒服，要不 Noriko 跑去给你拿瓶水什么的？
: 当然！

lines.en: : But it looks to me like he could just be suffering from an anxiety attack.
lines.zh: : 不过在我看来，他可能只是焦虑发作。

lines.en: : Before I leave, how about you try closing your eyes and counting to ten? We’ll do some breathing exercises together.
lines.zh: : 在我走之前，你要不要试着闭上眼睛数到十？我们一起做点呼吸练习。

lines.en: : No...Noriko. I {i}really{/i} think it’s dehydration. It would be {i}very{/i} nice if you were able to get him some water.
lines.zh: : 不……Noriko。我{i}真的{/i}觉得是脱水。你要是能给他拿点水来就{i}太{/i}好了。

lines.en: : Preferably from the vending machine on the ground floor.
lines.zh: : 最好是一楼自动贩卖机的那种。

lines.en: : What? Why? There’s one right outside of our door and they just restocked it this morning.
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？我们门外就有一台，而且他们今天早上刚补的货。

lines.en: : I remember specifically because I’ve been craving Coca-Cola ever since my sister’s commercial and I had to wait for them to finish before buying one.
lines.zh: : 我之所以记得特别清楚，是因为自从我姐姐的广告之后我就一直馋可口可乐，而我还得等他们补完货才能买。

lines.en: I reach toward Kirin’s lap to return the favor, thinking that I’d be able to remain just as stealthy as she is.
lines.zh: 我伸手向 Kirin 的腿间，想回报她一下，觉得自己能和她一样神不知鬼不觉。

lines.en: However, it is extremely hard to mutually [masturbate] underneath a table while maintaining eye contact with someone uninvolved.
lines.zh: 然而，在桌子底下互相[masturbate]、同时还要和一个无关的人保持眼神接触，实在太难了。

lines.en: And even though this should probably be instilling some sort of nervousness in me, I’m really just more impressed at how easily Kirin was able to pull it off.
lines.zh: 而且虽然这大概该让我有点紧张，但我真的更佩服 Kirin 居然能这么轻松地做到。

lines.en: : Hey...you two just moved closer together, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你们俩刚刚是不是靠得更近了？
: 没有。说回 Netflix 吧。

lines.en: : And now your face is getting red...
lines.zh: : 还有你的脸在变红……

lines.en: : Then maybe I...need some water as well...{i}Noriko...{/i}
lines.zh: : 那么也许我……也需要点水……{i}Noriko……{/i}
: 好渴。

lines.en: : Could this be the end for me?
lines.zh: : 这难道就是我的终点了吗？
: 我就知道！
: 那是……{i}我的{/i}阴茎？

lines.en: : I don’t think she’ll buy that the same way she bought the knee thing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不会像买膝盖那套说辞一样买这个。

lines.en: : I knew those knees were too big to actually be yours!
lines.zh: : 我就知道那些膝盖太大了，根本不可能是你的！

lines.en: : They {i}were{/i} mine! And they're totally normal knees!
lines.zh: : 那就{i}是{/i}我的！而且是完完全全正常的膝盖！

lines.en: : And after I {i}specifically{/i} told you two no funny business under the kotatsu!
lines.zh: : 我明明{i}特意{/i}跟你们说过别在被炉底下搞事情！

lines.en: : What do you have to say for yourself, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你有什么要为自己辩解的吗，Kirin？
: 要把脚挪开吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! We had a rule to not do stuff like this in front of each other!
lines.zh: : 当然不！我们明明有规矩说不在彼此面前做这种事！

lines.en: : That’s why I was asking you to go get water specifically from the first floor...
lines.zh: : 所以我才特意让你去一楼接水……

lines.en: : I’m obviously not going to just {i}leave{/i} and let you hook up with the man I’m in love with!
lines.zh: : 我显然不会就这么{i}走开{/i}，让你和那个我爱的男人搞在一起！

lines.en: : Have some dignity and do it behind my back! Not in my brand new kotatsu!
lines.zh: : 有点尊严，背着我做！别在我的全新被炉里做！
: 哦，还有一件事！我——
: 等等，还有？

lines.en: : Noriko! You’re making it even harder!
lines.zh: : Noriko！你让它更硬了！

lines.en: : Holy shit, it’s bigger than my foot.
lines.zh: : 我操，它比我的脚还大。
: 嘿嘿嘿……
: 感觉舒服吗？

lines.en: : Oh my God. Noriko, just leave.
lines.zh: : 我的天。Noriko，你走吧。
: 老师~

lines.en: : Okay, you need to stop or your kotatsu really will be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 好了，你得停下来了，不然你的被炉真的会被毁掉。

lines.en: : Hah...and to think that this is all because Noriko chose to watch some shitty movie when we could have just put on Stranger Things.
lines.zh: : 哈……想想看，这全都是因为 Noriko 非要放这部烂片，而我们本来可以直接放《怪奇物语》的。
: 好——吧。拜拜，小兄弟~
: 下次再见~

lines.en: : Or until my roommate stops cockblocking me...
lines.zh: : 或者等我室友不再妨碍我的好事……

lines.en: Noriko and Kirin both remove their respective appendages from me and I am suddenly stricken by a level of grief that is incomparable to anything else I have ever felt before.
lines.zh: Noriko 和 Kirin 各自把她们的肢体从我身上收了回去，我突然被一种前所未有的悲伤击中。

lines.en: : I feel like there was a much easier solution to this than just stopping in the middle.
lines.zh: : 我觉得比起就这么半途停下，明明有简单得多的解决办法。

lines.en: : There are two beds in here. Why didn’t we use one of those?
lines.zh: : 这里有两张床。我们为什么不用其中一张？

lines.en: : Dude, that’s not the same at all.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，那完全不一样。
: 真的不一样。

lines.en: : Like, the thrill of getting caught is what makes it hotter. So I applaud Kirin for trying.
lines.zh: : 就是说，会被抓到的刺激感才让它更带劲。所以我还是佩服 Kirin 敢试。
: 我们真的不继续了吗？

lines.en: : Mm...I’m kind of tired now. I think I'm just going to go to sleep.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我有点累了。我想我干脆就睡了吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think I’m going to go take a shower.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想我去洗个澡。
: 为什么会变成这样？
: 晚安，老师！

lines.en: : Oh, and we totally wouldn’t have gotten caught if you didn’t try to finger me. So this was your fault.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你不试图用手指弄我的话，我们根本不会被抓。所以这是你的错。

lines.en: : Ahhh! Shotgun is banned in our room from now on! That should have been me!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！从现在起我们房间禁止叫副驾了！那本该是我的！
我讨厌 Dorm 10。
{i}Kirin 的好感度提升到了 [kirin_love]!{/i}
